title: Baidu Autocomplete Scraper
description: Expand Baidu search phrases into autocomplete suggestions with position, phrase text, and match details. Batch seed terms to compare localized keyword ideas.

batch.title: Search queries
batch.description: Seed phrases to expand with Baidu autocomplete.
batch.valueDescription: Phrase submitted for these autocomplete suggestions.

schema.description: Search Query sent to the source search.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Find Baidu autocomplete phrases with suggestion text, match type, and position. Batch seed queries to explore Chinese search demand and export keywords.
storeCopy.intro: Expand seed phrases into Baidu autocomplete suggestions with rank, suggestion text, and source markers. Batch searches to compare related keyword ideas across topics.
useCases: SEO teams can discover related phrases people enter in Baidu search.
Product teams can map localized wording around products and services.
Content planners can compare autocomplete suggestions across multiple seeds.
howToUse: Add one seed phrase to `queries` for each lookup.
Set `maxResults` to limit the number of suggestion rows saved.
Review each suggestion with its source phrase and rank.

faqs.question: Are suggestions translated to English?
faqs.answer: No. Baidu returns suggestions in the language and market associated with the query.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Rank of this suggestion in Baidu autocomplete results.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Query text returned for the suggestion entry.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Suggested search phrase users may enter next.

fields.name: is_direct
fields.description: True when Baidu marks the phrase as a direct query match.

fields.name: sa
fields.description: Baidu source marker associated with the suggestion.

fields.name: q
fields.description: Normalized suggestion query text returned by Baidu.

fields.name: no_ai_sug
fields.description: True when Baidu marks the phrase as excluded from AI suggestions.

fields.name: input_query
fields.description: Baidu seed phrase submitted to retrieve autocomplete suggestions.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
